steps.name: Given the company actor is signed in for profile editing
When the company updates their profilePicture to "https://example.com/test-photo.jpg"
Then soft assert profile update status is 400

profile update status; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-01T08:54:40.678","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"Unknown or inaccessible upload reference","path":"/api/users/2543","requestId":"REQ-803154a3","messageKey":"error.attachment.unknown_upload"}
When the company updates their companyDescription to "E2E Test Description - Updated at timestamp"
Then soft assert status 200 for description update

companyDescription update status; response body: {"id":2543,"firebaseUserId":"E2ECOMPANY1793523256276","userType":{"value":"COMPANY","label":"Firma","originalLabel":"COMPANY"},"email":"company1@e2e.test","firstName":"E2EUpdatedFirst","lastName":"E2EUpdatedLast","name":"E2E Test Company Updated","profilePicture":"/api/dev-lite/files/content/E2ECOMP
And soft assert GET /users/me returns updated description
When the company creates address with street "E2E Test Street" city "Warsaw" postalCode "00-001" country "Poland"
Then soft assert address creation status is 200 or 201

address creation status — got 201; response body: {"id":2510,"userId":2543,"street":"E2E Test Street","city":"Warsaw","postalCode":"00-001","country":"Poland","addressType":"SECONDARY","lastUpdateTime":"2026-11-01T08:54:40.712766579","sourceType":"CUSTOM","updaterId":"E2ECOMPANY1793523256276","copied":false,"shared":false,"primary":true}
And soft assert address appears in user addresses
created address 2510 present in the user's address list
When the company updates the created address city to "Kraków"
Then soft assert address update status is 200

address update status; response body: {"id":2510,"userId":2543,"street":"E2E Test Street","city":"Kraków","postalCode":"00-001","country":"Poland","addressType":"SECONDARY","createdTime":"2026-11-01T08:54:40.712276","lastUpdateTime":"2026-11-01T08:54:40.713978","sourceType":"CUSTOM","updaterId":"E2ECOMPANY1793523256276","copied":false,"
When the company deletes the created test address
Then soft assert address deletion status is 200 or 204
address deletion status — got 204; response body:
When the company updates preferences with language pl
Then soft assert preferences update status is 200
When the company updates preferences with sharePhoneForPayments false
Then soft assert preferences update status is 200
When the company updates profilePicture and companyDescription together
Then soft assert batch update status is 400

batch profile update status; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-01T08:54:40.779","status":400,"error":"Bad Request","message":"Unknown or inaccessible upload reference","path":"/api/users/2543","requestId":"REQ-5fc03c72","messageKey":"error.attachment.unknown_upload"}
And soft assert GET /users/me returns updated description
Then all soft assertions should pass
